messages:
lina: hey team — quick design review request. attaching a mock of the ‘handoff banner’ that shows on a canary when you transfer ownership to another team. trying to land copy + ARIA behavior before dev work. screenshot: https://redwood.design/snap/hand-off-01.png :eyes:

raj: looks good visually. question: do we want the banner to be dismissible? currently the mock has a small "x" but there are cases where we want it to persist until acknowledged by the new owner.

oliver: product note — for audit clarity it should persist for 24h or until acknowledged. dismissible could cause confusion for compliance customers. maybe make dismissible only for self-serve accounts.

emma: accessibility nits: if it persists we need to announce it via screen reader focus or aria-live so it doesn't get lost. also keyboard dismissal needs to be reachable (Esc or Enter).

raj: good call. proposed behavior: banner appears with focusable "Acknowledge" button. if unacknowledged after 24h it turns into a sticky info chip in the version history.

lina: updated microcopy option A/B: A) "You transferred this canary to Team X. Acknowledge to confirm you received the handoff." B) "Ownership moved to Team X. Click Acknowledge to confirm you’ll monitor this rollout." which reads better?

sam: prefer B — shorter and action-oriented. also matching existing product tone. :+1:

emma: slight tweak for clarity and SR: "Ownership moved to Team X. Press Acknowledge to confirm you will monitor this rollout." plus add aria-live="polite" on the container and move focus to the button on show. e.g.

```
aria-live="polite"
role="status"
// when showing
element.querySelector('button.ack').focus();
```

raj: implementation question — if focus jumps, will that disrupt keyboard users browsing timeline? we should only move focus when the banner is triggered by an explicit user action (e.g., transfer), not on page load.

lina: agreed. UX rule: only auto-focus for in-page context change triggered by the current user. for passive listeners (e.g., page refresh) show banner but don't steal focus. we can show a subtle pulse on the ack button to draw attention.

oliver: also adding a tiny help link inside the banner: "Why this appeared" -> opens modal with audit info + recent deployment events. keeps the banner minimal but discoverable.

emma: confirm keyboard shortcuts: allow Space/Enter to activate Acknowledge, and Esc to dismiss if dismissible tier. need to document in a11y checklist.

raj: dev note: we'll add an event to telemetry when ack/dismiss happens, and surface in rollout timeline events as: "Acknowledged by X at t". deploy-bot will post an automated message to the channel when OEM transfers happen?

deploy-bot: automated: canary-ownership-transfer detected for canary-id=cr-1987, from alice -> team-x at 2026-03-23T16:02:00Z.

lina: final asks for engineering: 1) implement aria-live+focus behavior (only on user-initiated transfers), 2) wire telemetry events, 3) surface ack in version history, 4) add small help modal copy (oliver will draft). raj can you estimate?

raj: rough estimate: 2 dev days + 0.5 QA + 0.5 accessibility review. I’ll put a PR up and link the mock.

sam: I'll slot it in the next sprint and add a feature flag so we can A/B test the persistent vs dismissible behavior for self-serve customers.

lina: thanks all. tagging followups: @emma please add checklist items, @oliver please drop modal copy, @raj ping when PR is ready. :party_parrot:
